name: Beijing Wandong Medical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Wandong Medical Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufactures, sales, and after-sale services of digital imaging equipment in China. It operates through two segments Medical Equipment Sales Business; and Medical Services and Others.
